profile.headline: Psychology student (10th semester) at UFF Niterói, with experience in clinical neuropsychology, psychological assessment, people management and behavior analysis.

assessment.title: How I understand psychological assessment
assessment.body: I advocate integrated psychological assessment, combining its pillars — interview, observation and the administration of psychological instruments — with listening that is humane and attuned to the sociocultural reality of the person being assessed.
assessment.closing: So I understand that no isolated technique outweighs welcoming the uniqueness of each person.

goal.title: What I want from psychology
goal.body: My main goal in psychology is to contribute to strengthening the profession, committing myself to its ethics and to a practice that is accountable for the real impact our work has on people's lives.
